notes.subject: il-biki tan-nixxigħat
notes.rationale: מבכי נהרות literally 'the weeping of the rivers' — the dripping springs; kept the literal picture of weeping/binding.

notes.subject: dak li hu moħbi
notes.rationale: תעלומה — the hidden thing brought to light; verse names the uncovering of secrets.

notes.subject: metafora tal-minjier
notes.rationale: Poem withholds what the miner seeks; the following verse asks where wisdom is found.

translation: Il-biki tan-nixxigħat rabat, u dak li hu moħbi ħareġ fid-dawl.
